args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessmentbasics WHERE atype = 'Emergency';

SELECT 
    a.primdx,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.patownerref) AS num_patients,
    AVG(patient_crisis_sum.crisis_total) AS crisis_rate
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a
JOIN assessmentbasics b ON a.asdkey = b.abkey
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        e.patref,
        SUM(t.crisisint) AS crisis_total
    FROM encounters e
    JOIN treatmentbasics t ON e.enckey = t.encref
    GROUP BY e.patref
) patient_crisis_sum ON b.patownerref = patient_crisis_sum.patref
GROUP BY a.primdx
ORDER BY crisis_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    a.primdx,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.patownerref) AS num_patients,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(patient_crisis_sum.crisis_total) AS numeric), 4) AS crisis_rate
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis a
JOIN assessmentbasics b ON a.asdkey = b.abkey
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        e.patref,
        SUM(t.crisisint) AS crisis_total
    FROM encounters e
    JOIN treatmentbasics t ON e.enckey = t.encref
    GROUP BY e.patref
) patient_crisis_sum ON b.patownerref = patient_crisis_sum.patref
GROUP BY a.primdx
ORDER BY crisis_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;
